items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: how many nights a week was the Savoy job? ... Six nights.

ctx.x: job and I was going to school and then I had a little studio and then I got married and I was makin' some nice money. I think I was makin' a hundred-and-fifty then. That was good money.
For sure...so how many nights a week was the Savoy job?
